entries.name: Events
entries.evidence: Terminal run: GET /api/runs/:id/events 200, lastEventId 322; UI useRunStream(null) at RunDetailPage.tsx:129 and EventsTab only renders local events at :978-1018 -> “No live events observed”.

defects.title: Agent drawer loses evidence badges: list enriches, detail endpoint does not
defects.chain: web/src/pages/AgentsPage.tsx:376-397 -> getAgent api.ts:393 -> GET /api/agents/:id app.ts:217-221 -> returns raw registry AgentDefinition (no badges/evidence)
defects.red: GET /api/agents/architect keys lack badges/evidence; GET /api/agents list architect has badges [registered,representative-live] and 5 evidence rows; live drawer for architect renders “No badge evidence”.
defects.fixSeam: src/server/app.ts:217-221 (share the AgentView enrichment helper/query used at :177-215); regression: GET /api/agents/architect includes badges/evidence and drawer shows live evidence.

defects.title: Routing candidates are persisted but never returned or rendered
defects.chain: web/src/pages/RunDetailPage.tsx:657-700 -> getRouting api.ts:434 -> GET /api/runs/:id/routing app.ts:283-307 -> route_decisions query only; route_candidates ignored -> candidates:[] hardcoded -> RunDetailPage.tsx:703-741 candidate branch never renders
defects.red: SQLite route_candidates: 2 rows for run_b8a8e239a57052f146 (19 total); live GET /routing returns decisions=2 candidatesTotal=0; Routing tab DOM has no Candidate table; API hardcodes model:null, qualitySource:prior, chosen:true.
defects.fixSeam: src/server/app.ts:283-307 query route_candidates/rejected_json and map model/qualitySource/sampleSize/chosen; regression: live routing response candidates length equals DB rows and Routing tab renders candidate rows.

defects.title: Revision file selection is accepted/stored but ignored
defects.chain: web/src/pages/RunDetailPage.tsx:214-221 calls reviseRun(...,files default []) -> api.ts:339-356 -> POST /api/runs/:id/revise app.ts:647-676 -> stores settings key revision_files:<runId> at :674 -> pipeline executeReviewRun src/server/pipeline/run.ts:204-280 never reads it; parentFiles all revised
defects.red: Static contradiction: grep finds revision_files only in app.ts:674; no read in src/server. A client-supplied files[] cannot restrict the child; all accepted parent files are revised.
defects.fixSeam: src/server/pipeline/run.ts:204-220 read revision_files and filter parentFiles; regression: revise with files=[A] alters only A and parent B hash unchanged.

defects.title: schema-valid badge path has no producer
defects.chain: src/server/app.ts:190 reads agent_evidence.badge=schema-valid -> UI EvidenceBadge -> only writer is pipeline/run.ts:42 recordAgentEvidence (badge representative-live); no schema-valid INSERT anywhere
defects.red: Live SQLite agent_evidence: only representative-live (27 rows); live /api/agents badge counts registered 37, representative-live 5, schema-valid 0; source grep finds no schema-valid producer.
defects.fixSeam: pipeline/run.ts agentStep after schema-validated call, or a dedicated evidence writer; regression: a successful agent step produces schema-valid evidence and the card/drawer displays it.

defects.title: POST /api/runs accepts malformed preset/model/thinking and creates a queued run
defects.chain: RunComposer.tsx:76-109 -> api.ts:316-327 -> app.ts:528-552 -> casts body.preset/model/thinking as never -> createRun manager.ts:79 (no runtime enum validation) -> 202 queued
defects.red: Temp-DB in-process POST /api/runs {preset:"bogus-preset",model:"bogus-model",thinking:"bogus-thinking"} -> 202; row preset=bogus-preset model=bogus-model thinking=bogus-thinking status=queued.
defects.fixSeam: src/server/app.ts:537-540 validate against PRESETS/MODEL_IDS/THINKING_MODES (Zod or explicit) and return 422 E_* before createRun; regression: invalid enum -> 422 and zero runs.

defects.title: Terminal run Events tab ignores persisted events
defects.chain: web/src/pages/RunDetailPage.tsx:129 disables useRunStream for terminal -> EventsTab :978-1018 receives empty local events; GET /api/runs/:id/events src/server/app.ts:585-600 is never called on the tab
defects.red: Completed run run_b8a8e239a57052f146: GET /api/runs/:id/events returns 200 with lastEventId 322; live Events tab DOM: “No live events observed … Snapshot last event id: 322”; network has no /events request.
defects.fixSeam: RunDetailPage.tsx:129/406/978-1018 fetch persisted events via getEvents (new api.ts helper) when terminal and render them; regression Playwright: terminal Events tab lists persisted event types.
